title: Onboarding visual asset generator — privacy-aware cropping & locale variants
creator: Elena Zhao
description:
Problem: Product and docs screenshots for onboarding and quickstart flows are inconsistent in framing, show potential PII (eg. email previews, API keys), and require manual per-locale edits. This slows releases and introduces brand regressions.

Goal: Ship a lightweight asset generator and export pipeline that outputs brand-consistent UI screenshots across breakpoints and locales, with automated privacy redaction, standardized crop/spacing rules, and optional localized text overlays. The generator should produce labeled artifacts for marketing, docs, and product pages and integrate with the release asset checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Generator can produce 3 breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop) from a single source composition
Automated redaction rules applied to defined field patterns (email, API key, phone number) with configurable masking levels
Crop templates enforce consistent white space and CTA placement across assets
Locale-aware overlays applied without truncation for supported locales (en, fr, de, es, ja)
Export includes metadata JSON with source id, locale, crop template, and redaction level
Integration proof-of-concept with release pipeline artifacts (PR links or storage path)
design_notes: Redaction rules: token masking by regex + optional blurred region for freeform user content; default mask style is inline ellipsis + brand-safe gray background
Crop templates: define safe area grid (8px baseline) with anchor rules that keep primary CTA inside 40% lower third
Locale strategy: prefer dynamic text overlays rather than baked-in raster text to avoid kerning/truncation issues; fallback to locale-specific comps for languages with long strings
Color & typography: assets must use brand palette tokens and component-level type tokens to guarantee parity with product CSS
Metadata: embed a single-line asset id and checksum in export filename to enable reproducible pipelines
tasks: Finalize template specs in Figma and export component tokens
Implement redaction library (regex + blur) and expose mask level setting
Build exporter that takes a composition + locale inputs and outputs 3 breakpoints
Add metadata JSON producer and store example artifacts in design S3 folder
Run cross-team review with PM and Eng; capture performance trade-offs for on-device vs server-side rendering
